summary: Authoritative Nathan-fork history after the pinned b7b85da9 payload contains new source, but no new exact-Qwen3.6 c1 decode or 4K whole-GTT mechanism clears the frozen admission threshold. The three fork-local commits on strix-halo-vulkan are prefill work plus correctness/tests. The additional HIP fullstack branch contains multi-token prefill tuning, future-model attention, or raw-GGML/Q8_1 MMVQ mechanisms already incompatible with or closed by hipEngine's exact T16/qmicro evidence. No GPU A/B or implementation is admitted.

platform_target.note: No hardware run was performed because source compatibility/scope gates fail before implementation admission.

findings.source_gate: The final gfx1151 specializations require S_v == 128 and n_tokens >= 2048; H == 32 selects eight waves and H >= 64 selects sixteen waves with input caching.
findings.scope: Multi-token prefill only. Canonical exact AR has n_tokens == 1.

findings.source_gate: Tile selection is under ids_dst and derives J from average expert columns; it is the multi-row MUL_MAT_ID path.
findings.scope: MoE prefill, not c1 decode. The 512-thread J128 result later proved incorrect and, after b6c5f8f wave partitioning, measured 1654 tok/s versus 1664 for 256 threads.
findings.decision: Do not transfer the invalid speed signal or rerun closed c1 tile ladders.

findings.family: MMVQ two-wave and Q8_1 activation cache
findings.source_gate: gfx1151 raw GGML Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K/Q8_0 c1 MMVQ selects two wave32 waves; graph evaluation can cache lossy Q8_1 activation records and clear them after the graph.
findings.compatibility: hipEngine production consumes expanded T16/qmicro weights with BF16 activation and requires byte-exact hidden/state. The external body consumes raw GGML rows and Q8_1 activation arithmetic.
prior_local_evidence: benchmarks/results/2026-07-01-q8-t16-pair-q8-1-dp4a-micro.json: prequantized Q8_1+dp4a is 1.67x to 2.40x slower than exact T16 over rows 2-4
benchmarks/results/2026-08-06-gfx1151-gguf-sh5-d1-raw-rowvec8-blocked.json: raw c1 layout is decode-positive but changed hidden/logit/recurrent state and loses 13.457% prefill
benchmarks/results/2026-08-05-gfx1151-gguf-sh-d1-gdn-input-audit.json: 64/256-thread dense-Q8 and Q8T16 Q8_1/dp4a retries are closed
findings.decision: No exact candidate with >=0.5 ms/token evidence; no repeat.

findings.scope: Quantized-KV tile dequantization already reviewed; the new BF16 stream-K route requires at least 1024 query rows, while compact-mask/DK512 work is DeepSeek V4 sparse attention. a95aee9 is a NaN and wave64 ballot correctness fix.
findings.hipengine_mapping: Production exact AR uses BF16 KV and KVLiveSpans; grouped INT8 decode already shares K/V across GQA heads. SH7 retains the exact long-context reducer and SH8/SH-A1 reject the remaining grouped/page-layout substitutions.

findings.finding: The apparent 512-thread gain came from waves addressing rows and sum[] out of bounds. Correct partitioning makes 512 threads no faster than 256 on the reported Qwen3.6 pp2048 workload.
findings.decision: Correctness lesson only; reject benchmark inheritance.

findings.family: DeepSeek V4 lightning indexer and profiling/tests
findings.scope: Future-model plugin work or instrumentation/tests, not the Qwen3.6 exact-model route.

generic_upstream_integration.remaining_scope: Model support, conversion, UI/server, vendor, tests, SYCL/OpenCL/CUDA-backend-specific work, or correctness/packaging changes with no transferable Qwen3.6 gfx1151 exact decode/GTT mechanism.

admission_result.reason: Every newly observed Qwen-relevant performance body is prefill-only, future-model-only, raw-format/Q8_1-incompatible with exact production, already covered by a closed local ladder, or invalidated by a correctness repair. No source delta removes persistent bytes from the Qwen3.6 private-c1 process.
admission_result.next: Keep SH16 production. Reopen only for a later source delta with exact c1 evidence, a separately demonstrated >=134.820-MiB 4K owner, or an explicitly approved system/runtime-memory investigation.

qualifications: The external pp2048 figures are publisher measurements, not hipEngine measurements.
The newest dev release is not correctness- or benchmark-validated by its publisher.
This audit does not claim that the external prefill fixes are ineffective; it finds that they do not target this campaign's remaining exact c1 decode or 4K GTT owners.
No closed SH10-SH18 benchmark was repeated.
